==Description==
'''Null Necromancer Charm''' is an exclusive charm introduced in the [[Null & Void Event#Null & Void Battle Pass|Null & Void Battle Pass]] as a reward for reaching Level 6 on the premium track. It had a cost of {{GumDrops|110}} or {{Robux|28}} to unlock, with a total cost of {{GumDrops|350}} or {{Robux|216}}. Prior to the 20% discount, it had a cost of {{Robux|36}} to unlock, with a total cost of {{Robux|274}}.

==Appearance==
'''Null Necromancer Charm''' appearance is based on the [[Null Necromancer]]. It has the [[Null Necromancer]] standing on a platform with a few spikes coming out of it. It can be seen holding a lantern in its left hand and its staff in its right hand. Black and purple smoke comes out of the charm.

The color of '''Null Necromancer Charm''' depends on the username color of the player in the chat, though it is purple in its inventory preview.
